authors: M. Gryschka, V. M. Gryanik, C. Lüpkes, Z. Mostafa, M. Sühring, B. Witha, S. Raasch
name: luh-data-for-turbulent-heat-exchange-over-polar-leads-revisited-a-large-eddy-simulation-study
notes: This data file contains the model code, a steering file for the simulations and plotting/data analyzing scripts (NCL) used for the publication "Turbulent heat exchange over polar leads revisited: A large eddy simulation study"
title: Data for "Turbulent heat exchange over polar leads revisited: A large eddy simulation study"

resources.description:
data/JOBS/lead_example/INPUT/lead_example_p3d: 
Steering file which need to be adapted for the different cases of the study

data/JOBS/lead_example/USER_CODE/user_module.f9:
user-code, which need to be compiled together with the PALM-code. Here the lead is defined at the surface boundary and turbulent fluxes for output are calculated.

data/Plotscript/
NCL-Script for plotting and analyzing model output data

/palm_model_system_v21.10
PALM-model in its version as it was used in the study.
resources.name: data.zip
